name: motionforge
description: AI motion design toolkit: describe a video and the agent writes the story and hooks, times the voice, picks a style and brand kit, picks one of 100 styles, builds 2D and 3D scenes in code (HyperFrames + three.js by default, Remotion optional, canvas for hand-drawn looks), makes talking 3D characters and photo avatars for faceless videos, renders, and checks its own work before delivery.
